name: WanAnimate2Cache (pose branch cache)
plain: Runs the Animate 2 pose branch once and reuses its block inputs across all later sampling steps instead of recomputing, since pose doesn't change with sampling step. The node's own text says about half the generation time at a cost of about 12.5 GB of RAM at 480×832/81 frames in bf16.
math: No skip test: pose-block inputs are stored once per distinct pose sequence (one slot per context window) and K,V are reprojected on read. Optional int8 or int4 storage. LRU eviction on low memory. Freed by ON_CLEANUP.

props.architectures: Wan Animate 2; docstring adds Qwen-Image 2.1 prefix K/V in the same class
